audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagreed with each other and with the packet chart — full gave Ryze Level 1 and Level 6, content gave him Level 1 and Level 6 as well, while the packet and the mirror give both to Gragas or to neither.
audit.why: Mirror settled the chart: Level 1 even, Level 2 Gragas, Level 3 even, 4-5 Gragas, 6 Gragas, first item Gragas, two items Ryze.
audit.corrected: Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Ryze with matching ratings, proposed as matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold Level 6 as a Ryze duelling spike.
audit.why: Realm Warp is a delayed group portal with no combat steroid, while Explosive Cask (100/85/70s) after a Body Slam is a genuine wall kill. Ryze's real spike is two items plus mana stacking.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten as Gragas's spike; the flip is at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early both claim Ryze must enter barrel range or walk to melee range at level 1, and no ability cooldown appears anywhere (the packet flags zero sequencing cues).
audit.why: Overload is 1000 range against Barrel Roll's 850 — Ryze out-ranges the poke. Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 (14s at rank 1) and is the cooldown the whole page tells you to track without ever naming it. Drunken Rage is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the step-back cue. Happy Hour heals on skill use, so extended trades need Grievous Wounds. Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux; without it, it is a slow he dashes out of.
audit.corrected: Range edge stated, Body Slam's 14s named as the green light, the Drunken Rage wind-up named as the tell, and anti-heal tied to the attrition war.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: 'Punish the cooldown hard' is not actionable without the number.
audit.corrected: Body Slam 14s at rank 1 added to the do-line and the interactions line.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Body Slams' and 'His Explosive Cask' — both false positives; the underlying names are correct.

edits.before: Realm Warp opens flanks and escapes, and your EQ DPS now duels most tops on their cooldown gaps.
edits.after: Explosive Cask after a Body Slam is a wall kill; Realm Warp adds no duelling power at 6.

edits.before: W root threatens jungle follow-up, but it's also your kite tool — spending it greedily is how you die.
edits.after: Body Slam plus Drunken Rage beats your level-2 root — hold W as the answer to his dash, not as poke.

edits.before: His engage and his escape in one button — punish the cooldown hard. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 — engage and escape in one; step up only inside that window.

edits.before: Track Gragas’s Body Slam: His engage and his escape in one button — punish the cooldown hard. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Body Slam (14s at rank 1): engage and escape in one. Drunken Rage's wind-up is an auto reset — step back on the wind-up, not the cast.

edits.before: You have only Q at level 1 and must enter his barrel range to trade — farm without engaging while he pokes freely with Q sustain.
edits.after: Overload reaches 1000 to Barrel Roll's 850, but Happy Hour heals the chip straight back — poke and farm rather than commit.

edits.before: Pre-Seraph's mana costs ration your combo rotations, and his tankiness lets him sustain through the reduced output — he out-grinds you in the resource war.
edits.after: Pre-Seraph's mana costs ration your rotations and Happy Hour heals the chip back — buy Grievous Wounds before you try to out-grind him in the resource war.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — you have only Q and must walk to melee range while Gragas can Q-throw barrels at range for poke and sustain with Drunken Rage. Do not push into the barrel hitbox and just CS. At level 2 Gragas's Body Slam (E) threatens a pre-root burst — he can dash THROUGH your W cast if your timing is late, so respect his level 2 all-in and treat W as a reactive counter rather than an opener. At level 3 your Flux loop is live: if he Body Slams in, let the dash land, root him immediately with W, then chain E-Q to bounce Flux through him and nearby minions for the punish. The bounce cascade is your equalizer — he has to walk INTO it to brawl.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — Overload reaches 1000 to Barrel Roll's 850, so you can poke first, but Happy Hour heals it straight back. Do not step into the barrel hitbox; just CS. At level 2 Gragas's Body Slam (E) threatens a pre-root burst — he can dash THROUGH your W cast if your timing is late, so respect his level 2 all-in and treat W as a reactive counter rather than an opener. At level 3 your Flux loop is live: if he Body Slams in, let the dash land, land Spell Flux so W actually roots rather than slows, then chain Q to bounce Flux through him and the minions. The cascade is your equalizer — he has to walk INTO it to brawl.

notes: Chart aligned to the packet and the audited Gragas-side mirror. Two factual fixes worth noting: the page twice told the player he must enter barrel range to trade at level 1, when Overload out-ranges Barrel Roll 1000 to 850; and the whole page tracked Body Slam without ever giving its 14-second rank-1 cooldown, which is the packet's 'no sequencing advice' defect.
